senses.gloss: f. (v. רָבָה) large, numerous, frequent; opp. מוּעָט; pl. מְרוּבִּים, מְרוּבּוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:5">Ḥag. I, 5</cite>; a. fr.—Sifra Tsav ch. XV, Par. 11 (<cite ref="M00252"><he>מדה</he></cite>) <he>מ׳</he> the more frequent act, v. <cite ref="M00561"><he>מוּעָט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 37a:4">Pes. 37ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 22b:8">Bets. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>פת מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00007"><he>עָב</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—
R. Hash. 4ᵇ, a. fr. מְרוּבֶּה the larger sphere, v. מוּעָט.—מְרוּבֶּה בְגָדִים the priest distinguished by a larger number of official garments (v.

Yoma VII, 5), i.e. the high priest during the second Temple when no anointing took place. Sifra Tsav, Par. 3, ch. V (ref. to Lev. IV, 5) מ׳ ב׳ מנין how do you know that the law refers to the high priest even when he has not been anointed? Hor. III, 4.
